scope: Repeated large authored raster cache policy and disk swap checks on actual Metal; bounded cycles, not long-duration collection qualification
checks: Every original and replacement float component compared bit-for-bit after disk restore, including signed zero, negative values and HDR values
Full 4000x3000 offscreen Metal RGBA8 readback compared before and after swap
Live size/count/TTL tightening with active display lease
Visible frame protection and background restore isolation
Full managed root pressure refuses restore without swap errors, then restore recovers
Canceled background restore leaves managed root accounting unchanged
Final managed root bytes zero after every large cycle
limitations: 32.857 seconds of cycle work is not hours of sustained operation
Each cycle creates a fresh cache and swap directory; long-lived collection cache remains unqualified by this test
Authored raster data does not qualify diverse image decoding or all 100 formats
Local filesystem is not a physical slow disk
Managed root does not account for independent test oracle arrays, process RSS or all driver allocations
HDR source floats and SDR offscreen output do not qualify physical HDR display
Ignored corpus test is not counted as passing
